name: @adrkit/portal
description: Builds the static, read-only decision portal for GitHub Pages from the @adrkit/sdk handle (ADR-0054). Private; bundled into the portal Action, never published.
//boundary: ADR-0054 clause 1: the only runtime dependency is @adrkit/sdk. This package never imports @adrkit/core or @adrkit/cli and spawns no `adr` process; scripts/check-deps.ts admits @adrkit/sdk alone. The SDK declares no exports map (ADR-0031 clause 8, asserted by packages/sdk/test/packaging.test.ts), so the import specifier is the subpath `@adrkit/sdk/src/index.ts`, resolved through this package's declared workspace dependency.
//purity: src/data/** is pure (ADR-0054 clause 3): no clock, file, environment, process, or network. ADR-0055's server calls buildPortalData directly. test/purity.test.ts enforces it. src/generate.ts is the only I/O.
//release: Private and unpublished. It reaches users only bundled into the nested portal Action (packages/ci/portal, ADR-0054 clause 2) and, later, the OCI image (ADR-0055).
